name: Control-structure burden readout from declared gate state and gauged head asymmetry, with refusal

statement.latest: \text{Let a declared control structure } c \text{ separate side } A \text{ (upstream/inside) from side } B \text{ (downstream/outside), each side declared as belonging to a zone via a map } \zeta(c,A), \zeta(c,B), \text{ with } \mathbb{Q}\text{-valued gauged levels } h_A(t), h_B(t) \text{ on a declared common datum, each within a declared staleness window, declared per-gauge resolutions } \varepsilon_A,\varepsilon_B>0, \text{ and a declared control state } g_c(t) \in \{\text{OPEN},\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING}(A\to B),\text{PUMPING}(B\to A)\}.\quad a_c(t) := h_A(t) - h_B(t).\quad \text{readout}(t) \text{ is a total function, refusal rows checked BEFORE gate-state rows, refusal rows in this fixed precedence:}\quad \boxed{\text{readout}(t) := \begin{cases} \text{REFUSED (UNDECLARED\_STRUCTURE)} & c \text{ not a declared structure} \\ \text{REFUSED (MISSING\_INPUT / STALE\_INPUT)} & \text{else if } h_A(t) \text{ or } h_B(t) \text{ missing or stale} \\ \text{REFUSED (DATUM\_MISMATCH)} & \text{else if } h_A, h_B \text{ declared on different datums} \\ \text{REFUSED (CONTROL\_STATE\_MISSING)} & \text{else if } g_c(t) \text{ missing or stale} \\ \text{GRADIENT\_ONLY (defer to PROP-FLOOD-04, pending sibling)} & \text{else if } g_c(t) = \text{OPEN} \\ \text{UNRESOLVED} & \text{else if } g_c(t)\in\{\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING}\} \text{ and } |a_c(t)| \le \varepsilon_A+\varepsilon_B \\ (\text{HIGHER\_SIDE}{=}A,\ \text{LOWER\_SIDE}{=}B) & \text{else if } g_c(t)\in\{\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING}\} \text{ and } a_c(t) > \varepsilon_A+\varepsilon_B \\ (\text{HIGHER\_SIDE}{=}B,\ \text{LOWER\_SIDE}{=}A) & \text{else } (g_c(t)\in\{\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING}\},\ a_c(t) < -(\varepsilon_A+\varepsilon_B)) \end{cases}}\quad \text{BURDENED, RELIEVED are terms of art for HIGHER\_SIDE, LOWER\_SIDE respectively, defined only under a declared non-OPEN state.}\quad \text{Persistence (a NEW construction of this proposal, reported alongside, not a branch of readout(t)): } P_c(k) := \text{count of consecutive ticks ending at } k \text{ with the same HIGHER\_SIDE.}
statement.note_ascii: For a declared control structure c between side A (upstream/inside) and side B (downstream/outside), each side declared as belonging to a zone via a declared map zeta(c,A), zeta(c,B) (which zone each side of c belongs to), with Q-valued gauged levels h_A(t), h_B(t) on a declared common datum, each within a declared staleness window, declared per-gauge resolutions epsilon_A, epsilon_B > 0, and a declared control state g_c(t) in {OPEN, CLOSED, PUMPING(A->B), PUMPING(B->A)}: a_c(t) := h_A(t) - h_B(t) (a spatial retained difference across the structure, PROP-FLOOD-04 lineage -- PROP-FLOOD-04 is a pending sibling proposal, PR #61, not yet merged). readout(t) is a TOTAL function, refusal rows checked before gate-state rows, in this fixed precedence: (1) REFUSED UNDECLARED_STRUCTURE if c is not a declared structure; else (2) REFUSED MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT if h_A(t) or h_B(t) is missing or outside its staleness window; else (3) REFUSED DATUM_MISMATCH if h_A, h_B are declared on different datums; else (4) REFUSED CONTROL_STATE_MISSING if g_c(t) itself is missing or stale; else (5), only once none of (1)-(4) fire: if g_c(t)=OPEN, the gradient-direction readout is declared inapplicable to this object -- defer to PROP-FLOOD-04's own direction/UNRESOLVED/refusal readout, since this object only reads a level asymmetry as HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE once free exchange is declared blocked or overridden; if g_c(t) is CLOSED or PUMPING (either direction), free exchange is declared blocked or overridden, and the level asymmetry is read directly: UNRESOLVED if |a_c(t)| <= epsilon_A+epsilon_B (asymmetry not distinguishable from zero at the combined resolution), otherwise the side with the higher gauged level is HIGHER_SIDE and the other is LOWER_SIDE (A is HIGHER_SIDE if a_c(t) > epsilon_A+epsilon_B, B is HIGHER_SIDE if a_c(t) < -(epsilon_A+epsilon_B)). BURDENED and RELIEVED are terms of art for HIGHER_SIDE and LOWER_SIDE respectively, used only under a declared non-OPEN state (CLOSED or PUMPING) -- they name a level reading, nothing else. Persistence P_c(k) := the count of consecutive ticks ending at k for which the same side was read HIGHER_SIDE is a NEW construction introduced by this proposal (not carried over from any parent); PROP-FLOOD-01 is cited only for its tick-indexing and epsilon-resolution discipline (finite ticks in N, a declared epsilon>0 as the sign threshold), not for a persistence count, which PROP-FLOOD-01 does not itself register. P_c(k) is reported alongside every HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE readout, purely as a duration count -- it is never converted into a statement about motive, fault, or intent.

definitions.c: a declared control structure (gate, weir, floodwall opening, or pump) separating two declared sides A and B; declaration source is an official routing/structure record (e.g. an irrigation-district or municipal drainage document), itself a readout, never assumed from map proximity -- a structure not backed by such a source is UNDECLARED_STRUCTURE
definitions.A, B: the two sides of the structure by declared topology only (A = upstream/inside, B = downstream/outside, per the declaring source); side labels are a topology readout, not a claim about relative protection priority between the two sides
definitions.zeta(c,A), zeta(c,B): a declared map from (structure, side) to a zone identifier -- which zone A's side of c belongs to, and which zone B's side belongs to. This map is itself a readout of the same official routing source that declares c, A, and B; PROP-FLOOD-05b consumes this map to attribute a structure's readout to the zones on either side of it, and a structure whose zeta map is undeclared for a given side cannot be attributed to any zone on that side (that side's zone-level aggregate treats the structure as not part of its declared boundary set)
definitions.h_A, h_B: Q-valued gauged water-level readouts on sides A and B respectively, each on a declared common datum and within a declared staleness window; a datum mismatch or staleness/absence is a determinate refusal, never silently assumed equal or current
definitions.epsilon_A, epsilon_B: declared per-gauge resolution constants > 0; MUST come from each gauge's own stated sensor resolution; absent a source, that gauge's epsilon is INSTINCT (a judgment call), never silently VERIFIED/MEASURED. Summed as epsilon_A+epsilon_B because a_c(t) differences two separately-resolved readings
definitions.g_c(t): the declared operational state of structure c at tick t, in {OPEN, CLOSED, PUMPING(A->B), PUMPING(B->A)}, itself a readout from a declared source (operator log, SCADA/telemetry, or manual declaration) carrying its own staleness; missing or stale state is CONTROL_STATE_MISSING, a determinate refusal distinct from a known OPEN/CLOSED/PUMPING state
definitions.a_c(t): h_A(t) - h_B(t), the retained head difference across the structure at tick t
definitions.HIGHER_SIDE / LOWER_SIDE: the primitive readout: the side (A or B) with the numerically higher (resp. lower) gauged level at tick t, read only while g_c(t) is declared CLOSED or PUMPING (i.e. free exchange is declared blocked or overridden) -- this is a readout of measured consequence at that tick, never a statement of motive or intent
definitions.BURDENED / RELIEVED: terms of art, defined as exactly HIGHER_SIDE and LOWER_SIDE respectively, used only under a declared non-OPEN state; introducing the second pair of names is a labelling convenience only and adds no readout beyond HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE
definitions.P_c(k): persistence count: the number of consecutive ticks ending at k during which the SAME side was read HIGHER_SIDE under this construction; a bare count, reset whenever the higher side changes, the gate state moves to OPEN, or the tick is REFUSED/UNRESOLVED. This is a new construction of this proposal -- PROP-FLOOD-01 is cited only for the shared tick/epsilon discipline it already registers, not as the source of a persistence count

recommended_use: Report readout(t) per declared structure per tick as one of {GRADIENT_ONLY(defer to PROP-FLOOD-04, pending), UNRESOLVED, (BURDENED=X,RELIEVED=Y), REFUSED(reason)}, always alongside P_c(k); never present P_c(k) as a cause, a policy target, or a fairness claim, and never aggregate across structures without separately checking each one's own staleness/datum/control declarations and its declared zeta(c,A), zeta(c,B) zone map.

parents.evidence: a_c(t) := h_A(t) - h_B(t) is a direct application of the workspace's own root primitive (a retained difference exists, delta_R = (a sharp b), Th_coqc per readout_genesis Part I 'THE ONE-LINE MASTER EQUATION') to the two sides of a declared control structure at the same tick.

PENDING SIBLING PROPOSAL (PR #61, not yet merged into the proposals lane). PROP-FLOOD-04 registers Delta_e(t) := h_u(t) - h_v(t) across a declared canal edge as a total function whose direction rows (u->v / v->u / UNRESOLVED) fire only once its own refusal rows -- including CONTROLLED and CONTROL_STATE_MISSING for an edge's declared control structure -- are cleared, and explicitly REFUSES a direction reading whenever that edge's structure is CLOSED or pumping, precisely because closed/pumping control can hold or reverse flow against the natural gradient. This proposal takes PROP-FLOOD-04's own REFUSED(CONTROLLED) case as its entry point and gives it positive content: instead of refusing outright, it reads the SAME head-difference construction as a HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE split whenever the structure IS declared CLOSED or PUMPING (the case PROP-FLOOD-04 declines to interpret), and defers to PROP-FLOOD-04's own gradient-direction reading unchanged when the structure is OPEN. The two objects are therefore complementary readouts of the same a_c(t)/Delta_e(t) retained difference, gated on the opposite branch of the same declared control-state variable; PROP-FLOOD-04's construction and refusal precedence are cited, not restated. This parent reference is retained pending PROP-FLOOD-04's own registration outcome and must be re-checked if PR #61 changes before merge.

PROP-FLOOD-01 registers a lag-k temporal retained-difference sign readout over finite ticks t in N against a declared resolution epsilon>0. This proposal cites PROP-FLOOD-01 ONLY for that shared tick-indexing and epsilon-resolution discipline (finite ticks, a declared epsilon as the sign threshold) -- PROP-FLOOD-01 does not itself register any persistence/duration count. P_c(k) is a NEW construction introduced by this proposal, not a reuse of a construction PROP-FLOOD-01 already contains; the citation is corrected here to avoid overstating PROP-FLOOD-01's own content.

EQ-001/C.01.v1 (RT-LEDGER-001, registry/CANONICAL.json): 'If the declared closed boundary preserves ledger L(n)=A n, then A(n1-n0)=0'. This proposal cites RT-LEDGER-001 only as an ANALOGY, not as a formal parent this object generalises: both concern a ledger across a boundary whose exchange term depends on a declared boundary condition, and reading HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE only when g_c(t) is CLOSED or PUMPING is loosely analogous to RT-LEDGER-001's closed-boundary case holding only when the boundary is declared closed. No formal derivation or generalisation relation to EQ-001/C.01.v1 is claimed here -- downgraded from an earlier 'generalises' framing that overstated the connection.

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part VI-A, B.2a 'Synthesis Bookkeeping -- Normal Forms, Lineage, Conservation, and Complexity', the generic conservation ledger with its J_n^obstructed term; and Part V-A, A.13 'Gate 2 -- Three-Valued Admissibility' (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines ~3768-3776)
genesis_compatibility.quote: "C(𝔖_{n+1}) − C(𝔖_n) = J_n^in − J_n^out + J_n^created − J_n^obstructed" and "This ledger is architecture, not a physics claim" (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, Part VI-A, B.2a); and "𝒞(ξ | c, 𝒯) ∈ {1, 0, ⊥}      1 admitted · 0 obstructed · ⊥ unresolved" ... "`⊥` (unresolved, \"not yet known\") and `0` (obstructed, \"actively blocked\") are two different statuses, not one collapsed \"no\"" (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines 3771, 3775-3776)
genesis_compatibility.note: A declared CLOSED or actively PUMPING structure is read as ANALOGOUS to a nonzero J_n^obstructed term on the ledger across that boundary: the structure obstructs (or actively drives) the exchange that an OPEN structure would let pass freely as a plain gradient -- this is an analogy for orientation, not a claim that this object computes or equals Genesis's own J_n^obstructed. Reading HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE from a_c(t) only when g_c(t) obstructs or actively drives the exchange, and deferring to a pure gradient readout when it does not, parallels Genesis's own distinction between an obstructed flux term and a free one. The construction's own three-way split -- GRADIENT_ONLY (defer), UNRESOLVED (⊥, |a_c(t)| indistinguishable from zero at combined resolution), and a determinate HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE pair (admitted, 1) -- maps onto Gate 2's three-valued admissibility exactly as PROP-FLOOD-04 already does for its own direction readout; each REFUSED reason (UNDECLARED_STRUCTURE, MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT, DATUM_MISMATCH, CONTROL_STATE_MISSING) is a determinate obstructed (0) case, never collapsed into the ⊥ (UNRESOLVED) branch.

claim_boundary: This is a readout of declared gate state and gauged levels, not a claim about intent, fault, or engineering design merit. No hydraulic flow-rate, discharge, or volume estimate is asserted. Tide can produce the same measured asymmetry a_c(t) as an actively closed gate; this construction never distinguishes the two by itself -- the declared control state g_c(t) is what licenses the CLOSED/PUMPING branch at all, and honest_caveats states this explicitly. BURDENED/RELIEVED (= HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE) and P_c(k) are total, first-class readouts of measured consequence at tick t (or over a window ending at k); they carry no claim about why g_c(t) holds the value it does, and BURDENED never implies that the labelled side is receiving or losing any transferred volume -- it reads a level, not a transfer.
honest_caveats: Tide can create the same head asymmetry a_c(t) as a closed gate; the declared control state g_c(t) is what licenses reading BURDENED/RELIEVED (HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE) at all -- this construction never infers g_c(t) from a_c(t) itself, and a source that cannot distinguish a tide-lock condition from an operator-closed gate must declare that ambiguity rather than have it silently absorbed into CLOSED.

BURDENED means the higher gauged level while free exchange is declared blocked or overridden; under PUMPING(A->B), B may receive pumped water and still read RELIEVED; the labels read level, not transfer.

Sides A and B are labelled purely by the declaring source's own topology (upstream/inside vs downstream/outside); this is a readout of declared structure, never an independent geographic or administrative judgement made by this object.

Persistence P_c(k) is a NEW construction of this proposal (PROP-FLOOD-01 is cited only for tick/epsilon discipline, not for a persistence count) and is a bare count of consecutive same-HIGHER_SIDE ticks -- it is never itself a causal claim, a duration-of-harm estimate, or a ranking input outside PROP-FLOOD-05b's own explicitly stated use.

PUMPING(A->B) and PUMPING(B->A) are both read identically by this construction's HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE branch (only 'CLOSED or PUMPING' matters for licensing the branch); the pump's own declared direction is retained in g_c(t) for context and for any other reader, but is not itself an input to which side is read HIGHER_SIDE -- that comes from a_c(t) alone.

PROP-FLOOD-04 (cited as a parent for the OPEN-state deferral) is itself a pending sibling proposal (PR #61), not yet merged into the proposals lane; this citation must be re-checked against PROP-FLOOD-04's actual registered form once that PR lands.

The zeta(c,A), zeta(c,B) side-to-zone map is a declared input this object depends on for downstream zone attribution (PROP-FLOOD-05b) but does not itself use or validate beyond requiring it be declared per side.
Not yet implemented or tested against any real control-structure gauge/state data; this is a design-stage proposal.

name: Zone net-relief count ordering readout from boundary burden readouts, with no-order and not-evaluable refusal

statement.latest: \text{Let a zone } Z \text{ have a declared finite set of bounding control structures } \partial Z := \{c : \zeta(c,\cdot)=Z\}, \text{ each with a PROP-FLOOD-05a readout at tick } t \text{ (via the declared side-to-zone map } \zeta\text{).} \quad R(Z,t) := |\{c\in\partial Z : \text{the } Z\text{-side of } c \text{ reads LOWER\_SIDE (RELIEVED)}\}|, \quad B(Z,t) := |\{c\in\partial Z : \text{the } Z\text{-side of } c \text{ reads HIGHER\_SIDE (BURDENED)}\}|, \quad \Sigma P_{rel}(Z,t) := \sum_{c: Z\text{-side RELIEVED}} P_c(t), \quad \Sigma P_{bur}(Z,t) := \sum_{c: Z\text{-side BURDENED}} P_c(t), \quad \text{net}(Z,t) := \big(R(Z,t)-B(Z,t),\ \Sigma P_{rel}(Z,t) - \Sigma P_{bur}(Z,t)\big).\quad \boxed{\text{result}(Z,t) := \begin{cases} \text{NOT\_EVALUABLE}(Z) & \partial Z \text{ undeclared or empty} \\ \text{NO\_ORDER}(Z) & \text{else if } \exists c\in\partial Z : \text{readout}(c,t) = \text{REFUSED} \\ \text{rank}(Z,t) & \text{else, the dense rank of } Z \text{ among all such zones by descending net}(Z,t)\text{, ties sharing one rank value, next distinct value at rank+1} \end{cases}}
statement.note_ascii: For a zone Z with a declared finite set of bounding control structures dZ := {c : zeta(c,side)=Z for some side of c}, each carrying a PROP-FLOOD-05a readout at tick t via the declared side-to-zone map zeta: R(Z,t) := count of boundaries in dZ whose Z-side reads LOWER_SIDE (RELIEVED); B(Z,t) := count of boundaries in dZ whose Z-side reads HIGHER_SIDE (BURDENED). UNRESOLVED and GRADIENT_ONLY boundaries are declared NEUTRAL: they contribute to neither R(Z,t) nor B(Z,t). SigmaP_rel(Z,t) := sum of P_c(t) over dZ's boundaries whose Z-side is RELIEVED; SigmaP_bur(Z,t) := sum of P_c(t) over dZ's boundaries whose Z-side is BURDENED (two separate, same-signed sums, never combined by simple addition). net(Z,t) := (R(Z,t)-B(Z,t), SigmaP_rel(Z,t)-SigmaP_bur(Z,t)) -- both components are signed differences, the second a signed persistence-weighted net-relief tie-break, never a same-sign sum. result(Z,t) is a TOTAL readout: NOT_EVALUABLE(Z) if dZ is itself undeclared or empty (Z has no declared boundary set to aggregate at all -- a separate category from NO_ORDER, reported in its own list); else NO_ORDER(Z) if any boundary in dZ is REFUSED (also its own separate list); else Z receives rank(Z,t), the DENSE rank of Z among all evaluable zones sorted descending by net(Z,t) -- zones with an identical net(Z,t) share the exact same rank value, and the rank value used by the next-lower distinct net(Z,t) is exactly one more than the shared rank (dense rank, e.g. 1,1,2,3 not 1,1,3,4); ties are NEVER broken by zone name, id, or any criterion outside the declared net(Z,t) tuple. The result is a readout of measured consequence at tick t, not a statement of intent, policy, or fairness.

definitions.Z: a zone (a declared area, e.g. a routing sub-area of an official flood-control network), whose identity comes from a declared official routing source (e.g. an irrigation/drainage-district routing memo or a municipal drainage-network document); the zone set is itself a readout of that source, never assumed from map shape alone
definitions.dZ: the declared finite set of control structures bounding Z, derived from PROP-FLOOD-05a's declared side-to-zone map zeta(c,A), zeta(c,B): dZ := {c : zeta(c,A)=Z or zeta(c,B)=Z}. A structure whose zeta map does not declare a side as belonging to Z is not in dZ. A zone whose dZ is itself empty or undeclared is NOT_EVALUABLE -- a separate, determinate category, never silently merged into NO_ORDER or given a default rank
definitions.R(Z,t), B(Z,t): counts, at tick t, of Z's declared boundary structures whose Z-side currently reads LOWER_SIDE/RELIEVED and HIGHER_SIDE/BURDENED respectively per PROP-FLOOD-05a; a boundary currently GRADIENT_ONLY (structure OPEN) or UNRESOLVED is declared NEUTRAL and contributes to neither count
definitions.SigmaP_rel(Z,t), SigmaP_bur(Z,t): the sums of PROP-FLOOD-05a's own persistence count P_c(t) over exactly those boundaries of Z currently RELIEVED (resp. BURDENED) for Z; kept as two separate same-signed sums whose SIGNED DIFFERENCE (SigmaP_rel - SigmaP_bur) is the declared tie-break key -- the two sums are never added together, since that would conflate a persisted relief pattern with a persisted burden pattern into one meaningless same-sign total
definitions.net(Z,t): the ordered pair (R(Z,t)-B(Z,t), SigmaP_rel(Z,t)-SigmaP_bur(Z,t)); both components are signed counts, reported together, never collapsed into or presented as a single unlabelled index or score
definitions.rank(Z,t): the DENSE rank of Z among evaluable zones (neither NOT_EVALUABLE nor NO_ORDER) sorted descending by net(Z,t): zones with identical net(Z,t) receive the same rank value; the next distinct net(Z,t) value receives exactly rank+1 (never rank+count_of_ties); ties are never broken by zone name, id, or any criterion outside the declared net(Z,t) tuple
definitions.NOT_EVALUABLE(Z): a determinate category for a zone whose declared boundary set dZ is itself empty or undeclared -- there is no PROP-FLOOD-05a readout set to aggregate; reported in its own list, separate from NO_ORDER and from ranked zones
definitions.NO_ORDER(Z): a determinate category for an evaluable zone (dZ declared and nonempty) that has at least one REFUSED boundary in dZ at tick t; reported in its own list, separate from NOT_EVALUABLE and from ranked zones

recommended_use: Report three separate outputs per tick: (1) a ranked list of evaluable zones with each zone's rank(Z,t) and its full (R(Z,t), B(Z,t), SigmaP_rel(Z,t), SigmaP_bur(Z,t)) so the ranking is auditable term-by-term; (2) a NO_ORDER(Z) list; (3) a NOT_EVALUABLE(Z) list. Never merge the three lists, never break a tie by name/id, never report R(Z,t)-B(Z,t) as a standalone index/score without also reporting R(Z,t) and B(Z,t) themselves, and never present rank(Z,t) as a claim about who should be protected -- only about the measured consequence readout at that tick.

parents.evidence: R(Z,t), B(Z,t), SigmaP_rel(Z,t) and SigmaP_bur(Z,t) are pure aggregates (counts and sums) over PROP-FLOOD-05a's own per-structure HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE/UNRESOLVED/GRADIENT_ONLY/REFUSED readout, its persistence count P_c(t), and its declared side-to-zone map zeta, for the boundaries attributed to Z. No new per-structure primitive is introduced, and PROP-FLOOD-05a's REFUSED case is propagated upward as this object's own NO_ORDER(Z) refusal rather than being silently excluded from the count.

Each term feeding R(Z,t) and B(Z,t) is itself built from PROP-FLOOD-05a's a_c(t) retained differences (delta_R instances) across Z's declared boundaries; this object adds only a counting, signed-difference, and dense-rank layer on top, no new retained-difference primitive.

PROP-FLOOD-03 already registers a declared gate_flag(k) in {OPEN, CLOSED} that gates a downstream computed quantity (Q_out(k) := 0 if CLOSED, else the measured/capped value), with REFUSED as a total, first-class outcome distinct from a silently defaulted/clamped value. This object follows the same precedent one layer up: a zone's aggregate (R, B, net, rank) is itself gated by the declared state of its boundaries (via PROP-FLOOD-05a's own g_c(t)-conditioned readout), and any REFUSED boundary forces the zone itself into the determinate NO_ORDER category rather than letting the aggregate silently proceed on partial data -- the same 'gate the computation, never default it' discipline PROP-FLOOD-03 already establishes for gate_flag. EQ-001/C.01.v1 is not cited here (downgraded out of this object's parent list; it remains only as a cited analogy in PROP-FLOOD-05a).

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part V-A, A.13 'Gate 2 -- Three-Valued Admissibility' (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines ~3768-3776), applied at the aggregate level
genesis_compatibility.quote: "`Adm = 1` ⇒ expand; `Adm = 0` ⇒ record the obstruction; `Adm = ⊥` ⇒ record it as unresolved and do not guess." (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines 3771-3776)
genesis_compatibility.note: A zone with any REFUSED (obstructed, 0-style) boundary is itself given the determinate refusal NO_ORDER(Z), rather than being ranked on an incomplete R(Z,t)/B(Z,t) computed only from the readable boundaries -- the same 'record the obstruction, do not guess' discipline Gate 2 states for a single admissibility certificate is applied here one level up, to a zone's aggregate ranking eligibility. A zone with an undeclared/empty boundary set is a distinct, prior case (NOT_EVALUABLE) -- there is no admissibility question to answer at all, since there is no declared boundary set to evaluate.

claim_boundary: result(Z,t) is an ordering of measured boundary-level consequences at tick t only, per the declared boundary readouts, and is explicitly NOT an intent, policy, engineering-design, or fairness judgement about any zone, structure, or the parties operating them. R(Z,t)-B(Z,t) is a signed count and must never be reported as a standalone index or score without also reporting R(Z,t) and B(Z,t) themselves. UNRESOLVED and GRADIENT_ONLY boundaries are declared NEUTRAL for this aggregate -- they are counted toward neither R(Z,t) nor B(Z,t), a declared convention stated here explicitly, not a claim that such a boundary has no bearing on Z. The dense-rank, descending-net(Z,t) convention (more net-relieved zones ranked first, ties sharing one rank, never broken by name/id) is a declared readout-presentation choice stated here explicitly, not a claim that a lower rank is unjust, intended, or wrongful. Zone identity and the boundary-to-zone map zeta are taken from a declared official routing source as that source's own readout, never inferred by this object.
honest_caveats: result(Z,t) at one tick carries no claim about result(Z,t+1); it is a per-tick readout, not a trend, forecast, or standing classification of any zone.

R(Z,t)-B(Z,t) treats every boundary equally regardless of the structure's size, capacity, or hydraulic significance; this is a count of readout classes, not a magnitude-weighted or capacity-weighted assessment, and must not be presented as one. R-B is a signed count and must never be reported as an index/score without also stating R and B.

A zone whose declared boundary set dZ is itself empty or undeclared is NOT_EVALUABLE and reported in its own separate list -- never folded into NO_ORDER, never given a default rank, and never silently omitted.

SigmaP_rel(Z,t) and SigmaP_bur(Z,t) are kept as two separate sums; only their signed difference is used as the tie-break, precisely because adding them directly (a same-sign sum) would conflate a persisted relief pattern with a persisted burden pattern into one meaningless number.

Dense rank means ties share one rank value and the next distinct net(Z,t) value continues at exactly rank+1 (e.g. 1,1,2 not 1,1,3); ties are NEVER broken by zone name, id, alphabetical order, or any criterion outside the declared net(Z,t) tuple.

UNRESOLVED and GRADIENT_ONLY boundaries are declared neutral (count toward neither R nor B) rather than propagated as a refusal at the zone level; this is a stated convention choice, not a claim that these boundaries are inconsequential to Z in any hydraulic sense.

This object inherits PROP-FLOOD-05a's own caveat in full: tide-driven and structure-driven asymmetries can be indistinguishable from the level readings alone, so every RELIEVED/BURDENED count feeding R(Z,t)/B(Z,t) is only as reliable as the declared control-state source behind each boundary's PROP-FLOOD-05a readout.
Not yet implemented or tested against any real zone/boundary declaration or gauge data; this is a design-stage proposal.
